name: Harem Academy: Tales of the Titty Tamer
detailed_description:
Ostracized for having a 'looked down on' ability used to Tame monsters, also your sleazy attitude and constantly leering at women doesn't do much for your reputation. Everything changes, of course, when you are out on a training exercise the super-epic drop turns out to be a tamer exclusive ring! The party you're with isn't too enthused but you're over the MOON! Finally, you time to shine and become a real force to be reckoned with, unless... what if the high level monsters you can tame are your fellow adventurers!?

A girl-next-door priestess type who is sworn to hear the troubles and ease the burdens of her fellow adventurers, your burden in this case being bloated scrote in need of a release. A bouncy wolf girl, there has to be a joke about teaching a dog new tricks in here somewhere... A quintessential haughty (also a hottie) blonde elf girl, you do NOT want a superiority complex in a Meil game I tell ya. The fuckable headmistress who, lets be honest, wont be a 'mistress' for long.

ALL these titanic titty wielders are helpless to resist your awesome POWERRR!

FEATURES

• Faithful recreation of the original Japanese Visual Novel

• All the female fledgling adventurers are fully voiced with original Japanese dialogue.

• Original artwork HD upscaled with 16:9 and 4:3 variants

• Click though and read hours of story content

• Audio including music and special effects

• Enhanced with animated character sprites

• A CG Gallery and Scene selections

• You're on a quest to cum! Read and enjoy over a dozen H-Scenes in this one!

• This title also supports any and all Lovense sex toy devices, great!

Harem Academy: Tales of the Titty Tamer is the English localization of a Visual Novel originally created by prolific Japanese developer Miel. We at Cherry Kiss aim to provide an authentic Japanese Visual Novel experience to gamers outside of Japan.

**PLEASE NOTE**

All characters described and visually represented in this game are over 18 years of age, and no actual, nor identifiable minor was used in the production of this game.
